Tandem on your watch

The watch gets its own key to Tandoor and fetches the shopping list itself, also when the phone is switched off. Check items off on the watch; they are sent when the watch has a network. Timers from cook mode show on the watch too.

Watches are not supported on this phone
Finding a watch needs Google Play services and the watch\'s phone app (for example Galaxy Wearable or Pixel Watch).
No watch nearby
Turn on Bluetooth and keep the watch close to the phone. The watch needs Tandem installed.
Tandem is not on %s
Install Tandem on the watch from a computer, then come back here. The guide explains how.

Tap Pair the watch. The phone creates a key just for the watch.

How to install Tandem on the watch
The key is only sent straight to a watch nearby, never through the cloud. The phone\'s own key never leaves the phone. Unpairing deletes the watch\'s key in Tandoor.
Not in demo mode. Demo mode never talks to a server, so there is no key for a watch. Log in to pair the watch.
Guests may only read in Tandoor, so the watch could not check anything off. The watch cannot be paired for a guest. Use the watch with a member account.
Log in to pair the watch.
The watch is paired. It fetches the list now.
The watch is unpaired and its key is deleted.
The watch\'s key is deleted. The watch was not nearby, so it asks to log in again until you pair it.
No watch with Tandem nearby. Keep the watch close to the phone and try again.
The watch did not take the key. Update Tandem on the watch and try again.
The key could not be created or deleted in Tandoor.
That is not possible right now.
